quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult watershed engineer in a rust coat and gray cap toward one blue funicular cabin at a frozen dam station. Hold the interior window as platform rails and dam towers move backward in continuous parallax. End with the engineer, cabin frame and upper reservoir visible together as the cabin continues upward.
